Patient: Elvina Schaden, 69 y/o F

Chief Complaint:
Back pain

Back pain since 09/13/2026 after bending to pick up a grandchild. No trauma reported. No radiation of pain.

Admission Details:
Adm 09/22/2026 intractable back pain, NRS 8/10 on IV opioids.

Past Medical History:
HTN, hyperlipidemia.

Physical Exam:
VS stable. Tenderness over lumbar spine. No focal neurologic deficits.

Assessment:
Severe back pain, likely musculoskeletal in origin.

Plan:
Continue pain control with IV opioids. Monitor neurologic status. Further imaging as indicated.

notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/18/2026
Patient: Elvina Schaden, 69 y/o F

Exam: MRI thoracic spine

Findings: MRI 09/18/2026: T11 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Intervertebral discs show mild degenerative changes without significant herniation or canal stenosis.

Impression: T11 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. No additional acute abnormalities detected.
